- Typical evidence we can provide quickly: architecture diagram, SOC2 cert summary, TLS configuration, retention policy for logs, and sample ACLs for model artifacts. The intake PDF lists the most common asks; Karthik (cc) is our security lead — he'll coordinate to provide the artifacts you need.

Next steps and deadlines (proposed):
- Jan 27: security intake completed by FinWave (you indicated this is feasible)
- Jan 29: 30-min sync between Marco + Karthik to align systems boundary and clarify question #4 (data retention / log forwarding)
- Feb 1: procurement kickoff (Priya) — commercial/contracting timeline aligned to your Feb target
